pr_title: [Feature] Add RoPE switch support to MLA preprocess
source_quote: Using `wuk.size(2)` directly assumes that `wuk` is always a 3D tensor. If `wuk` is 2D (e.g., in folded weight configurations), this will throw a `c10::Error` (Dimension out of range) and crash execution. Since `kv_lora_rank` is always the last dimension of `wuk`, using `wuk.size(-1)` is much safer and works robustly for both 2D and 3D tensor representations.

rule.description: 访问张量特定维度时，若该维度始终为最后一维，应使用负索引 `size(-1)` 而非绝对索引 `size(N)`，避免张量秩变化时越界崩溃。
checkpoints: 检查 `tensor.size(N)` 是否假定张量固定秩数
若目标维度始终为最后一维，改用 `tensor.size(-1)`
